applicableAreas: Eastern boundary along overhead electric distribution line
findings.comment: Landscape Plan (Sheet 31) shows approximately six tree symbols positioned 10-15 feet from overhead electric line along eastern boundary. Plant species identified in Sheet 35 Plant Schedule. However, utility compatibility (UC) status cannot be verified without ECM Appendix F; exact lateral clearance distances from conductors cannot be verified without dimensional documentation; and conductor position detail prevents accurate clearance measurement. Unable to determine if proposed trees comply with 15-foot distribution clearance requirement.

applicableAreas: Eastern boundary within 25 feet of overhead electric distribution line
findings.comment: Plant Schedule (Sheet 35) lists proposed trees but does NOT specify mature heights required to determine if trees meet 40+ feet threshold for large trees. ECM Appendix F reference not provided. Landscape Plan (Sheet 31) does not differentiate large trees from smaller trees. Exact lateral distances from trees to distribution line not dimensioned on plans. Unable to verify compliance with 25-foot large tree clearance requirement.

applicableAreas: Eastern and southern boundaries where overhead electric poles located
findings.comment: Utility poles shown schematically as small symbols on Site Plan (Sheet 9) and Landscape Plan (Sheet 31). Vision analysis confirms tree symbols within 10-15 feet of poles, including at least one existing tree within 10 feet. However, specific pole locations not dimensioned; exact relationship between proposed tree locations and specific poles cannot be verified. Proposed tree symbols lack cross-reference to plant schedule. Without dimensional documentation and clear tree identification, compliance with 10-foot pole clearance requirement cannot be verified.

applicableAreas: Entire site where trees proposed near overhead electric facilities
findings.comment: Landscape Plan and Plant Schedule do not provide mature height information for proposed trees. Plant Schedule lists only container sizes and caliper inches, not mature heights. Landscape Plan does not mark or differentiate large trees (40+ feet) from smaller trees. Mature height reference to ECM Appendix F required but not provided.

applicableAreas: Eastern and southern boundaries where overhead electric infrastructure located
findings.comment: Landscape Plan (Sheet 31) depicts overhead electric line schematically but lacks sufficient detail to verify clearances. Utility pole locations shown only as small symbols without dimensions. Conductor positions not shown (typically offset 4+ feet from pole centerline). No cross-reference dimensions, easement boundaries, or detailed utility plan information on Landscape Plan. Relationship between proposed trees and overhead electric infrastructure cannot be verified due to insufficient utility detail.

applicableAreas: Eastern boundary where trees proposed within restricted clearance zones from overhead electric distribution line
findings.comment: Landscape Plan shows approximately six tree symbols positioned 10-15 feet from overhead electric line along eastern boundary, within restricted clearance zone for distribution facilities. No documentation of explicit written approval from Austin Energy authorizing trees in this restricted zone is visible on submitted plans or supplementary documents. Plans must include documented Austin Energy written approval if trees are proposed within prohibited zones, or clearances must be revised to comply with minimum distances.
